unit.metreOrMinute.meaning: The intentionally shared lowercase notation for a metre or a minute. Multiple valid interpretations can produce multiple answers to one expression.
unit.metreOrMinute.context: Lazy resolution uses constraints across the expression. Multiple valid interpretations produce possible answers. Display identical-looking formatted answers once, without captions, while preserving every underlying interpretation and exact value. For example, 2m * 2 displays one 4m; 10m / 2s displays 5m/s and 300. Independent occurrences may resolve differently. Check the supported-unit families after final cancellation: (2s * 3s) / 1s can produce 6s despite an intermediate time square. Discard interpretations with an unsupported final unit and show the remaining valid answers; show an unsupported-unit error only when no supported interpretation remains. Other branch errors, ordering and copy selection remain open. Do not silently truncate the set of distinct visible answers.
unit.metreOrMinute.location: Unit positions in expressions and results, including nested quantities. The chosen result layout is a horizontally scrolling row without interpretation captions. Completion descriptions are retained separately.
